description: Dependency updates. Minor, patch, pin and digest updates auto-merge once the required checks pass; majors wait for a human. CI and build-image updates are reviewed by hand, because they change what runs on every pull request.

customManagers.description: The runtime image's rustup install, so it moves with rust-toolchain.toml instead of drifting (it was 1.90.0 against a 1.93.1 toolchain).

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once required checks pass.
One PR per ecosystem for non-major updates.
In-range npm minors only reach the weekly PR if the lockfile is updated for them; the default would wait for lockFileMaintenance.
Rust toolchain in its own PR: rust-toolchain.toml, the builder image and the runtime rustup install together. A new clippy lint set must not block the weekly group.
CI and build-image updates change what runs on every pull request: reviewed by hand.
